## Why This Is Asked

- Cloud Armor, HTTP(S) Load Balancer, Cloud Run behind LB

```bash
# create policy

```

## Why This Is Asked

- Istio/Anthos VirtualService for tenant-based split
- Canaries by tenant label and time window
- Artifact Registry for container images
- Cloud Monitoring alert policies for latency and error rate
- Minimal IAM roles for building, deploying, and alerting

## Code Example

```yaml
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1alpha3
kind: VirtualService
metadata:

spec:
```
